description: This file defines interfaces and constants for the Android sensors hardware abstraction layer (HAL) multihal implementation, including callback interfaces, sub-HAL interface, and a factory function for dynamic loading.

classes.name: IHalProxyCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks from sub-HALs to the HalProxy, including event posting and wake lock management.

classes.name: ISensorsSubHal
classes.description: Interface that sub-HALs must implement to support Android sensors multihal 2.0, including initialization, debugging, and identification.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Thread-safe callback to deliver sensor events to the framework, with wake lock management.

methods.name: createScopedWakelock
methods.description: Creates and optionally locks a ScopedWakelock for wake lock management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sub-HAL, resets state, and sets up communication with the HalProxy.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information about the sensor HAL state.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the sub-HAL.
